_comment: M-ARC A2: the Raskghar descent canonical. Loads the deep_descent_start FIXTURE (sewers, facing the deep_fissure at (8,12), `heard_the_deep_tremor` pre-banked so the fissure's door_when gate is MET) via title Continue. Flow: interact the fissure -> DESCEND to deep_tunnels (open_toast + map_changed) -> read the Cold Hearth flavor prop -> clear the raskghar_scouts route-fight (combat_autoplay, no ally -- the party/veto is A3) -> read the Gnawed Bones flavor prop -> reach the Warren Mouth (the 'warren door', terminal beat). Proves: the new descent seam, the deep_tunnels dark map + mood + ambience, the two Raskghar scout combatants + their sprites in a real fight, and the three flavor toasts. FIXTURE-NOTE FOR A3: the Awakened BOSS fight (deep_warren arena) rides A3's chain -- A3 wires the boss encounter at/beyond warren_mouth + the Relc party/veto; this script STOPS at the warren door. Fixture rng_state (9) governs the scout autoplay (overrides --seed).

steps._comment: Down 1 selects Continue, confirm loads the deep_descent_start fixture.
== DESCEND ==. Already facing DOWN onto the fissure (8,12); the door_when gate is MET -> open_toast, then transition to deep_tunnels (2,2).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: You lower yourself into the fissure. The sewer's damp falls away behind you, and a dry, ancient cold rises to meet your hands. The dark below swallows the last of the light from above.

steps._comment: == COLD HEARTH (5,4) flavor ==. Down 2 to (2,4), right 2 to (4,4), then right 1 bumps the hearth (5,4, blocked prop) -> face it, interact.

payload_contains.text: A fire-pit ringed with blackened stones, its ashes cold. Whoever tended it had hands enough to strike a spark — and left gnawed bones banked around the edge, cracked for their marrow.

steps._comment: == RASKGHAR SCOUTS (8,4) route-fight ==. The hearth blocks y4, so route over the top: up 1 to (4,3), right 4 to (8,3), then down 1 bumps the scouts (8,4) -> face them, interact.
Field READ: the raskghar_scout encounter sprite in the deep_tunnels dark mood, one cell above it, before the fight starts.
steps.name: 01b_scout_field

steps._comment: Dismiss the victory banner (non-tutorial arena, no tutor line -- confirm-then-hide, sewer_vermin precedent).
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: == GNAWED BONES (9,6) flavor ==. The scout cell (8,4) still blocks, so route right: right 1 to (9,3), then down 3 bumps the bones (9,6) -> face them, interact.

payload_contains.text: A heap of gnawed bones, splintered for their marrow. Some are Gnoll. One is a Drake's. They are stacked, not scattered — and somehow that is worse than if they had been.

steps._comment: == WARREN MOUTH (12,5): the 'warren door', terminal beat ==. Right 2 to (11,5), then right 1 bumps the warren_mouth (12,5) -> face it, interact. A3 wires the boss here.

payload_contains.text: The tunnel widens into a pillared gallery, the air stirring with breath that is not your own. Something large shifts in the dark ahead, and the pacing scuffs go quiet. You have found the warren.
